title: Exceptional point structure and chiral state transfer in a rate-operator-engineered $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric Bose-Hubbard dimer
summary: The rate operator quantum jumps (ROQJ) is a general method to unravel a master equation describing the dynamics of an open quantum system into stochastic pure state trajectories. By post-selecting on no jumps occurring, one obtains a trajectory generated by a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. The ROQJ allows for versatile modification of this non-Hermitian evolution, with each non-Hermitian Hamiltonian corresponding to a different continuous measurement scheme.
